title: Why Your Phone Battery Gets Low

cover.alt: A gray-haired woman holds up a phone showing a nearly full battery.

blocks.title: Phone Battery Life
paragraphs: Your phone battery life can change from day to day. The battery gets low faster when the phone uses more energy. You will learn what uses that energy and four simple ways to save it.

items.prompt: How many hours does your phone battery usually last in one day?
items.answer: Answers will vary. For example: 'My phone lasts about eight hours.'

items.prompt: Does your phone get hot sometimes? When does this happen?
items.answer: Answers will vary. For example: 'My phone gets hot when I play games.'

items.prompt: Do you charge your phone at night while you sleep?
items.answer: Answers will vary. For example: 'Yes, I always charge my phone at night.'

blocks.title: What Is Inside Your Phone Battery
paragraphs: Many modern phones use a rechargeable lithium-ion battery. It stores energy for the phone. Each time you charge and use the battery, it changes a little. After many months or years, it cannot hold as much energy as before. Apple calls this chemical ageing. It is a normal part of battery life.

images.alt: A cutaway phone shows its lithium-ion battery and battery capacity decreasing over time.

items.prompt: What happens to a rechargeable phone battery over time?
items.answer: It slowly changes and cannot hold as much energy as before.

blocks.title: Heat Is Bad for Your Battery
paragraphs: Heat is hard on a phone battery. A hot battery can lose power quickly, and heat can make it age faster. Do not leave your phone in a hot car or in strong sun. If the phone gets very hot, move it to a cooler place and let it cool.

images.alt: A gray-haired woman reaches for a hot phone on a sunny car dashboard.

items.prompt: What should you do when your phone gets very hot?
items.answer: Move it to a cooler place and let it cool.

blocks.title: Screen Brightness and Apps Use Power
paragraphs: The screen and busy apps can use a lot of energy. A bright screen needs more power. Video, maps, and games can also use power quickly. Lower the screen brightness and let the screen turn off sooner. Your battery settings can show which apps use the most power.

items.prompt: Name two ways to use less battery power.
items.answer: You can lower the screen brightness and let the screen turn off sooner. You can also check which apps use the most power.

blocks.title: Good Charging Habits
paragraphs: You can charge your phone when you need to. You do not have to wait until the battery is at zero, and you do not have to charge it to 100 percent every time. Use the charger made for your phone or another charger that the maker says is safe to use. When you need more time, turn on Battery Saver or Low Power Mode.

images.alt: A gray-haired woman looks at one phone charging and another in power-saving mode.

items.prompt: Must you wait until the battery is at zero before you charge your phone?
items.answer: No. You can charge your phone when you need to.

items.prompt: Think about your phone today. Which one will you try: use a dimmer screen, let the screen turn off sooner, keep the phone cool, or use Battery Saver? Why?
items.answer: Answers will vary. For example: 'I will use a dimmer screen because my screen is usually very bright.'
